title: 用于发现重大数学猜想的LLM框架：AI对下一个黎曼猜想的探索
summary: 提出一个三阶段流水线，用于系统生成和验证重大数学猜想，包括区域搜索、反思性验证和Lean 4形式化验证。实验显示20个候选全部通过解析和类型检查，未被现有策略自动解决，且无重复。
summary_en: A three-stage pipeline for systematic generation and validation of major mathematical conjectures, including region search, reflective validation, and formal verification in Lean 4. Experiments show all 20 candidates pass parsing and type checking, none are auto-solved, and no duplicates.
